b1-eeuu-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Monroe Doctrine
b1-eeuu-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the United States and Latin America, and he asks what Monroe declared.
b1-eeuu-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what President Monroe declared in 1823.
cues: Say who declared it and in what year
Say what the European countries should not do
b1-eeuu-01.target: En 1823 el presidente Monroe declaró que los países europeos no debían fundar nuevas colonias en América.
b1-eeuu-01.english: In 1823 President Monroe declared that the European countries should not found new colonies in America.
b1-eeuu-01.canDo: I can report what a president declared, moving the tense back.

b1-eeuu-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Panama Canal
b1-eeuu-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg is writing an essay for her class and asks you about the Panama Canal.
b1-eeuu-02.prompt: Tell Meg what happened in Panama while the canal was built.
b1-eeuu-02.target: Mientras se construía el canal, llegaron a Panamá muchos trabajadores. El canal se abrió en 1914.
b1-eeuu-02.english: While the canal was being built, many workers arrived in Panama. The canal opened in 1914.
b1-eeuu-02.canDo: I can link events in the past with *cuando* and *mientras*.

b1-eeuu-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Bananas and Dependence
b1-eeuu-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos have just read a book about United Fruit, and he asks why bananas mattered.
b1-eeuu-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what some small countries depended on.
cues: Say which product some economies depended on
Use a relative clause with a preposition
b1-eeuu-03.target: El banano era el producto del que dependía la economía de varios países pequeños.
b1-eeuu-03.english: Bananas were the product on which the economy of several small countries depended.
b1-eeuu-03.canDo: I can say what a country depended on using *del que* and *con los que*.

b1-eeuu-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Alliance for Progress
b1-eeuu-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you about a museum visit where you saw the Alliance for Progress.
b1-eeuu-04.prompt: Tell Meg how the programme ended.
cues: Say that the programme stopped working
b1-eeuu-04.target: A principios de los años setenta el programa dejó de funcionar.
b1-eeuu-04.english: In the early 1970s the programme stopped working.
b1-eeuu-04.canDo: I can say how something began, stopped or went on with verbal periphrases.

b1-eeuu-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Closing Summary
b1-eeuu-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are preparing a class presentation on the United States and Latin America.
b1-eeuu-05.prompt: Give Carlos the closing sentence of your presentation.
cues: Say that the relationship was unequal
b1-eeuu-05.target: En resumen, la relación fue desigual, pero no fue solo de dominación.
b1-eeuu-05.english: In summary, the relationship was unequal, but it was not only one of domination.
b1-eeuu-05.canDo: I can build and close an argument with *en primer lugar*, *además* and *en resumen*.

b1-eeuu-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Short Report
b1-eeuu-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you what you remember from the class about the United States and Latin America.
b1-eeuu-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg one thing about Monroe and one about the Panama Canal.
cues: Say when Panama received the canal
b1-eeuu-consolidation.target: Monroe declaró que los países europeos no debían fundar nuevas colonias. Panamá recibió el control del canal en 1999.
b1-eeuu-consolidation.english: Monroe declared that the European countries should not found new colonies. Panama received control of the canal in 1999.
b1-eeuu-consolidation.canDo: I can report what a president declared and say who said what.
